requirement_ref.quote: Contact information including an email address and a support phone number. Copyright information and a system disclaimer.

preconditions: STAGE is reachable and the home page loads

The footer's copyright line currently renders a mangled character where a © symbol is presumably intended (see thinking/analysis/ecommerce-2026-09-12.md, Additional findings). This mission checks the surrounding text only, not the symbol itself, to avoid depending on an encoding artifact that may or may not be intentional.
test_objective: Verify the footer displays required contact information.

assertions.statement: The support email address is visible in the footer.
The support phone number is visible in the footer.
A rights-reserved disclaimer is present in the footer (checked by substring, not the exact copyright symbol — see precondition note).
